title: Role Card

runtime.description: openai = light employee; devin = Devin session; openai->devin = OpenAI plans, Devin executes

instructions.description: Path to playbook/instructions file; becomes a Devin playbook when runtime=devin

tools.description: Hosted tools, e.g. code_interpreter, file_search, web_search

mcp.description: Allow-listed MCP server names — enforced by gateway (FR-I05)

deliverables.description: Expected output paths/types, e.g. report.md, charts/
